dent_cnt.long_description: Count of dentists located within each geographic area, based on geocoded provider addresses from the WebMD Physician Directory. Areas with zero or very few dentists may indicate dental care deserts where residents face barriers to routine and preventive oral health services.
dent_cnt.short_description: Number of dentists per geographic area from the WebMD Physician Directory.
dent_cnt.provenance: Provider addresses scraped from WebMD Physician Directory (2022), geocoded to lat/lon, and snapped to nearest 2020 Census block group centroid. Counts aggregated from block group to tract and county levels.

dent_2sfca.long_description: Dental care accessibility measured using the two-step floating catchment area (2SFCA) method with a 30-minute travel time threshold. This index captures both the supply of dentists and the demand from surrounding populations, identifying areas where residents may struggle to access dental services due to provider scarcity or high competition from neighboring communities.
dent_2sfca.long_name: Dental care geographic availability (2-step floating catchment areas)
dent_2sfca.short_description: Dentist-to-population accessibility ratio using the 2SFCA method with a 30-minute catchment.
dent_2sfca.provenance: Spatial access scores computed using the 2-step floating catchment area (2SFCA) methodology (Luo, 2004). Provider locations from WebMD (2022), snapped to block group centroids. Consumer population from ACS 5-year (2021) table B01001_001 at block group level for VA, MD, and DC. Travel times from pre-computed OSRM block-group-to-block-group matrices. Scores expressed per 1,000 population.
dent_2sfca.statement: The dental care availability for {features.name} is {value}.

dent_e2sfca.long_description: Dental care accessibility measured using the enhanced two-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) method, which applies distance-decay weights within stepped travel time zones (10, 20, 30, and 60 minutes). Unlike the binary 2SFCA, E2SFCA recognizes that closer providers are more accessible, producing a more realistic picture of dental care availability across the region.
dent_e2sfca.long_name: Dental care geographic availability (enhanced 2-step floating catchment areas)
dent_e2sfca.short_description: Dentist-to-population accessibility ratio using the E2SFCA method with stepped distance-decay weights.
dent_e2sfca.provenance: Spatial access scores computed using the enhanced 2-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) methodology (Luo & Qi, 2009). Stepped weights: 10 min=0.962, 20 min=0.704, 30 min=0.377, 60 min=0.042. Provider locations from WebMD (2022), consumer population from ACS 5-year (2021) B01001_001 at block group level. Travel times from OSRM BG-to-BG matrices. Scores expressed per 1,000 population.
dent_e2sfca.statement: The dental care availability for {features.name} is {value}.

dent_3sfca.long_description: Dental care accessibility measured using the three-step floating catchment area (3SFCA) method with Gaussian distance decay. This variant accounts for competition among consumers for provider capacity and applies a smooth Gaussian weight function, providing the most nuanced estimate of spatial access to dental services.
dent_3sfca.long_name: Dental care geographic availability (3-step floating catchment areas)
dent_3sfca.short_description: Dentist-to-population accessibility ratio using the 3SFCA method with Gaussian distance decay.
dent_3sfca.provenance: Spatial access scores computed using the 3-step floating catchment area (3SFCA) methodology with Gaussian decay (scale=20). Provider locations from WebMD (2022), consumer population from ACS 5-year (2021) B01001_001 at block group level. Travel times from OSRM BG-to-BG matrices. Scores normalized by competition weights.
dent_3sfca.statement: The dental care availability for {features.name} is {value}.

dent_near_10_mean.long_description: Mean drive time in minutes to the ten nearest dentist locations from each block group. This measure captures the travel burden residents face when seeking dental care, with higher values indicating greater geographic isolation from dental providers.
dent_near_10_mean.long_name: Mean drive time to ten nearest dentists
dent_near_10_mean.short_description: Average driving time in minutes to the ten closest dentist locations.
dent_near_10_mean.short_name: Mean drive time to nearest dentists
dent_near_10_mean.provenance: Drive times from OSRM pre-computed block-group-to-block-group travel time matrices. For each consumer block group, the 10 nearest provider block groups (by travel time) are identified and the mean travel time computed. Provider locations from WebMD (2022). Aggregated to tract and county by simple mean.
dent_near_10_mean.statement: The mean drive time to the ten nearest dentists from {features.name} is {value} minutes.

dent_near_10_median.long_description: Median drive time in minutes to the ten nearest dentist locations from each block group. The median is less sensitive to outlier travel times than the mean, providing a robust measure of typical travel burden for accessing dental care.
dent_near_10_median.long_name: Median drive time to ten nearest dentists
dent_near_10_median.short_description: Median driving time in minutes to the ten closest dentist locations.
dent_near_10_median.short_name: Median drive time to nearest dentists
dent_near_10_median.provenance: Drive times from OSRM pre-computed block-group-to-block-group travel time matrices. For each consumer block group, the 10 nearest provider block groups (by travel time) are identified and the median travel time computed. Provider locations from WebMD (2022). Aggregated to tract and county by simple mean.
dent_near_10_median.statement: The median drive time to the ten nearest dentists from {features.name} is {value} minutes.
